events.verdict: Vassell (SAS) legally contests LaRavia's (LAL) jump shot attempt.
Ayton (LAL) is in the lane for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Hachimura (LAL) and Champagnie (SAS) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Hachimura (LAL) is moving alongside Castle's (SAS) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during the drive.

Replay review of the foul called on Wembanyama (SAS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Wembanyama initiates contact with Hachimura (LAL), who has established himself in a legal guarding position in Wembanyama's path prior to the contact.
LaRavia (LAL) firms up over his leg in Castle's (SAS) path before the contact.
Vassell (SAS) is drawn into the air on the pump fake toward Doncic (LAL) at the end of the drive, and the contact is marginal.
Barnes (SAS) initiates contact with Ayton's (LAL) arm as he receives the ball, and the contact is more than marginal.
Castle (SAS) is in LaRavia's (LAL) path before the contact and moves back with him as he pushes through.
Champagnie (SAS) keeps his left heel elevated above the sideline and he does not step out of bounds at the start of his drive.
Doncic (LAL) legally contests Champagnie's (SAS) jump shot attempt.

Replay review of the out of bounds called on Ayton (LAL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful.  Johnson (SAS) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds, and possession is awarded to the Lakers.
LaRavia (LAL) is firming up over his right leg in Castle's (SAS) path and he absorbs the contact to his upper body.
Vassell (SAS) and LaRavia (LAL) come together when attempting to get to the loose ball.
Champagnie (SAS) initiates contact with Hachimura's (LAL) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Smart (LAL) is moving alongside Johnson's (SAS) path and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Smart (LAL) jumps alongside Johnson's (SAS) path and he absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Sochan (SAS) commits a take foul on Smart (LAL).
Smart (LAL) legally contests Vassell's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Smart (LAL) does not fully establish himself out of bounds prior to releasing the inbounds pass.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Spurs.
Smart (LAL) and Johnson (SAS) legally attempt to get to the inbound pass.
Possession is awarded to the Spurs. Johnson (SAS) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession should have been awarded to the Lakers.

LaRavia (LAL) swipes his arm down and initiates contact with Champagnie (SAS) that affects his shot attempt near the rim.  After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined the foul occurred prior to the expiration of the game clock, and the game clock was reset to 0.2 seconds.
Johnson (SAS) briefly grasps Hayes' (LAL) jersey as they pursue the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Hayes (LAL) contests Johnson's (SAS) shot near the rim, and the contact that occurs after Johnson has released the shot is marginal.
